authorityBoundary: ADR is rationale input only. Accepted package contract authority lives in governance-records-main package-contract records. Generated feat inputs are derived work inputs, not approval authority. Executable audit code stays in ops.
consequences: Raw ADR rows can explain the reason for the promotion bridge but cannot approve merges or package placement.
Issue lifecycle state cannot become accepted contract state.
The ops implementation must be bound by governance-records package contract and feat input records.
context: governance-records-main/records/specs/package-contract.v1.jsonl is the accepted package contract source of truth.
governance-records-main/generated/feat-inputs/adr-specs-promotion-kernel.json is the generated feat work input.
adrs-main remains a semantic rationale input and is not slated for deletion like the old contract repo.
decision: Keep ADR rationale, accepted package contract authority, generated feat input, and ops executable audit implementation separate.

layoutBoundary.src: lib only: core and adapter behavior stays in ops src modules

title: Define ADR promotion bridge contract and ops implementation boundary
